question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Ex-investment-gain GAAP EPS from guidance (rev $108B±2%, 74% GM, $9.2B GAAP opex, ~17% tax, ~24.2B shares) plus typical beat to ~$111B gives ~$2.53, consistent with non-GAAP consensus $2.47-2.53 (GAAP-nonGAAP opex gap only ~$0.2B now). GAAP has exceeded non-GAAP via equity mark-to-market gains ($15.9B Q1, $7.8B Q2) on a ~$95.6B portfolio. calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: (1) SpaceX share price at the start of Q3. Run 1's ~$106 comes from a 'below peak' statement in Wikipedia. Runs 2 and 3 give $116.49 on Jul 28 and 'the $120s through July', with the ~$105 low on Aug 5, which is inside the quarter. I take a starting price of ~$116-125, which gives ~+$3-3.7B rather than Run 1's +$6-8B. (2) Intel's move within the quarter: Run 2's share count and prices (214.8M shares, $92.32 to ~$87-90) give about -$0.5 to -1.2B. Run 1 ignored this. (3) CoreWeave: Runs 1 and 3 both show a large October drop (~-$1.7B). Run 2 did not check it. (4) OpenAI round timing: all runs agree it was not closed by ~Oct 25, though this is not fully settled, so it stays as right-tail risk. Judgment: how much routine private-stake gain to expect (H1 had $7.5B). I assume ~+$1B. The net of ~+$2B pre-tax plus an operating base of ~$2.52 puts the median near Run 2's $2.60, between Run 3's flatter marks and Run 1's inflated SpaceX gain.
